meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

howto.what: 接手 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 迁移的收尾部分:读取 handoff.json、修复卡住的步骤、给所有者授权、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置、搬运 v1 自定义代码。
howto.when: 在终端跑完 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 之后使用;当你提到「migrate from v1」「finish migration」等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我跑完 migrate-v2.sh 了,帮我收尾
say.note: 它会先读 handoff.json 看各步结果

say.text: 继续完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移
把 v1 fork 的自定义内容搬到 v2
say.note: 会列出提交让你选如何处理

howto.what_en: Takes over the human-judgment parts of finishing a NanoClaw v1 to v2 migration: reads handoff.json, triages failed steps, grants the owner role, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container.json, and ports v1 fork customizations.
howto.when_en: Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` finishes in your terminal. Also triggers when you mention "migrate from v1", "finish migration" or "v1 migration".

say_en.text: I've run migrate-v2.sh, help me finish the migration
say_en.note: It reads handoff.json first for step results

say_en.text: Continue finishing the v1 to v2 migration
say_en.note: Works through the phases as written

say_en.text: Port my v1 fork customizations to v2
say_en.note: It lists commits and asks how to handle them
